scope: Import specimen A (MorphoSource 000875604, Macaca mulatta USNM 497136-3, infant, 160um CT) identified bones into the matter construction system as the first membrane layer: every identified bone one compartment (triangles-are-weights residency), bonds-are-materials at the measured touching edges, stage-true at scale 1.0. No engine, gait-lane, or visual-repair files touched.
membrane_frame: Operator doctrine 2026-09-20: mesh data with triangles is all we need -- translate the triangles into the matter kernel's triangle format and define MEMBRANES with them. Bones are the first membrane layer (compartments, per the anatomy pivot); muscles are the next membrane layer over the bone compartments; skin eventually. This lane is that doctrine's first instance.

rule_0.statement: The infant skeleton can be expressed AS MATTER without inventing a single number: the bone meshes' own triangles carry real mass (volume from those triangles x literature cortical density), and the bond graph is exactly the measured bone-to-bone adjacency (touching_edges with gaps to hundredths of a mm) -- so the matter-system skeleton is the measured infant creature, not an authored one.
rule_0.prediction: (a) Triangle-integrated compartment volumes reproduce the voxel-counted manifest volumes (total within 5%; only the 30000-face-decimated axial composite rank 1 may exceed 1% deviation, predicted near -3%). (b) The resulting total skeleton mass lands in the 30-65 g window, i.e. 8-15% of a 400-550 g infant rhesus body -- with the adult-density upper anchor biasing HIGH vs the adult-taxon Prange regression (predicted 25.5-29.6 g), a deviation that must be NAMED, not tuned away. (c) A definition built this way passes the matter kernel's own parser/validator unmodified (no side format).

falsifiers.geometry_preserved: Each bone compartment's mesh loaded back from the committed matter definition matches the source OBJ: face count equal, referenced vertex count equal, per-axis bbox extents within 1e-3 mm (float32 quantization floor ~2.4e-5 mm at 200 mm coordinates), sha256 of canonical float32 vertex serialization equal between source and blob. Any loss itemized per compartment, never averaged away.
falsifiers.adjacency_reproduced: The definition's bond set IS the measured touching_edges set: same 21 pairs (4 chains: 6+7+4+4 edges), zero invented joints, zero dropped joints, and each bond's rest_length_mm equals the measured gap_mm exactly (hundredth-of-a-mm resolution). Singletons (ranks 14, 16, 19) and the axial composite (rank 1) have NO measured adjacencies in bone_identification_v3.json, so they get NO bonds -- the body's 8 connected components are the honest reading, and cross-component joint measurement is named successor work, never invented here.
falsifiers.mass_book: Per compartment: stated mass equals kernel-derived mass (area x thickness x density, validator 5% law) and equals volume x density with thickness := V/A (the derived equivalent shell thickness, the only parameter, derived not authored). Books: sum(mesh volume) vs sum(voxel volume) within 5%; total skeleton mass in 30-65 g and fraction of the 400-550 g infant body band within 8-15%, OR the deviation named and explained with the adult-density-upper-anchor (Rauch 2001: infant bone under-mineralized) and CT-threshold (95th percentile includes partially mineralized growth cartilage) biases cited -- never tuned.
falsifiers.kernel_conformance: tools.matter_kernel.definition.parse_body succeeds on the committed infant_skeleton.body.json, and the kernel's own suite stays green: test_definition 9/9 OK plus the full kernel battery (test_scratch, test_glue, test_tensile, test_drape, test_residency; 37 OK at baseline). The import uses the kernel's format, not a side format.
falsifiers.stage_true: The body carries stage=infant with provenance (MorphoSource media 000875604 metadata + download_receipt species/specimen fields) and scale=1.0; the import writer applies NO transform to source vertex coordinates (identity, proven by the geometry hashes); no allometric scaling code path exists in the tool (the H2 3.79-8.8x per-bone stretch factors are the named negative example).
falsifiers.regressions: creature_graph tests: 19 passed from the repo root AND from tools/ (both PYTHONPATH roots); matter kernel suites: all OK.

rule_1_derivation_plan.note: Every number below is derived or cited; the tool authors none.
rule_1_derivation_plan.volume_law: V_k = |sum over faces (1/6) * v_a . (v_b x v_c)| -- divergence theorem on the compartment's own triangles (the exact triangles that go resident), CT mm frame.
rule_1_derivation_plan.area_law: A_k = sum over faces 0.5*|(v_b - v_a) x (v_c - v_a)|.
rule_1_derivation_plan.thickness_law: t_k = V_k / A_k -- the equivalent shell thickness that conserves the measured volume; with it the kernel's mass law (area x thickness x density) reproduces V_k * rho exactly. This is the only derived parameter; it is computed per compartment, never chosen.
rule_1_derivation_plan.mass_law: m_k = V_k * rho_bone; rho_bone = 1900 kg/m^3 = 1.9e-6 kg/mm^3, literature cortical wet density, adult range 1800-2100 (Cowin Bone Mechanics Handbook / Currey, Bones: Structure and Mechanics; Feldmann et al., European Cells & Materials 1800-2100). Adult-tissue value used as cited UPPER ANCHOR because no infant-macaque tissue-density citation exists; infant bone is under-mineralized (Rauch 2001, physiological osteoporosis of infancy), so masses bias HIGH -- named, not tuned.
rule_1_derivation_plan.bond_law: Bond set = union of the 4 chains' touching_edges in bone_identification_v3.json (21 edges). Per bond: members = the two bone compartments, material = cartilage, cure_strength = 13 MPa (Yamada 1970, Strength of Biological Materials: cartilage tensile strength ~13 MPa, modulus 7-25 MPa, density ~1.06 g/cm^3), rest_length_mm = measured gap_mm (0.38-2.91 mm range). Bond geometry is measured, not authored.
rule_1_derivation_plan.total_check: M_skel = sum m_k. Literature band: M_body in [400, 550] g (rhesus infant birth mass, NC3Rs macaque care guidelines; ~650 g at 4 weeks) with skeleton fraction 8-15% of body mass (mammalian range; BioNumbers bone-mass-fraction records; Prange, Anderson & Rahn 1979, Am Nat 113:103-122, M_skel = 0.0708 * M_body^1.09 -> 25.5-29.6 g over the band).

limits_and_successors: Specimen B (875599) out of scope for this lane.

The measured adjacency covers limb chains only; the axial composite (rank 1) and singletons (14, 16, 19) are unmeasured for adjacency, so the body has 8 connected components. Successor: extend the touching-edge measurement to axial-limb pairs (femur/pelvis, rib/spine is intra-composite).
Muscles are the next membrane layer over these bone compartments; skin eventually (operator membrane-layer roadmap).
Adult-density upper anchor: when an infant-macaque tissue-density citation is found, re-derive the mass book with it (one constant change; the derivation law does not move).

measurements.prange_arithmetic_note: the pre-registered prediction hand-computed the Prange band as 25.5-29.6 g; the in-code regression gives 26.08-36.9 g (0.0708 * M^1.09 for M in [0.40, 0.55] kg). The slip is in the prose sub-number only; the binding falsifiers (30-65 g window, 8-15% fraction band, named deviation) are unaffected and all measured. Recorded, not edited away.

corrections.trigger: VERIFICATION RED: the lead's fresh clone refused this lane's definition_drift gate; this repair is the one itemized fix, no re-derivation.
corrections.finding: The committed infant_skeleton.body.json source_obj_sha256 values were sha256 of the LANE WORKING COPY's OBJ bytes, not the canonical committed bytes: the lane clone checked out meshes_preview BEFORE the .gitattributes -text rule for morphosource_ct existed in that clone, so autocrlf delivered CRLF text OBJs to the writer while the GIT BLOBS are LF. The provenance hashes were environment-dependent -- a Copernicus-EOXML-class byte-stability defect. The original 'byte-exact fresh clone' claim had NOT been a true fresh-clone proof: git does not re-normalize an existing working tree after .gitattributes changes, and verify's byte gate compares the WORKING TREE against regeneration -- in a stale worktree that proves tool determinism only, not committed-bytes reproducibility.
corrections.repair: Regenerated in a TRUE fresh clone of the branch after proving the byte baseline first: all 25 preview OBJs git hash-object == git rev-parse HEAD:path (worktree bytes == committed blobs, LF-only). The regenerated body.json differs from the committed one by EXACTLY 25 insertions + 25 deletions, every changed line a source_obj_sha256; derivation.json, verify.json and all 25 triangle blobs are byte-identical. The hashes are now sha256 of the canonical committed (LF) bytes.
corrections.scope: ONLY the 25 provenance hash fields changed. All geometry, mass, bond and adjacency numbers stand unchanged: 25 compartments, 21 measured bonds, total 52.3139 g, books as banked above (vertex_sha256 values are canonical float32 vertex records and were never EOL-sensitive).
corrections.proof_standard_correction: The reproducibility proof standard for this lane is hereby sharpened: verify green in a TRUE fresh clone of the branch (worktree==blob pre-checked), not in the authoring worktree.
